title: Middlemarch
description: A sweeping portrait of a provincial English town, centred on the idealistic Dorothea Brooke and her disastrous marriage, tracing how private ambitions collide with the constraints of society.

title: Beloved
description: A woman who escaped slavery is haunted, literally, by the daughter she killed rather than see returned to bondage, in a novel about memory, trauma and the cost of freedom.

title: Ulysses
description: A single Dublin day, 16 June 1904, follows Leopold Bloom and Stephen Dedalus in a modernist epic that reshaped what the novel could do with language and consciousness.

title: To the Lighthouse
description: The Ramsay family's summers on the Isle of Skye, split by the first world war, become a meditation on time, loss and the effort to make art from fleeting experience.

title: In Search of Lost Time
description: A vast, multi-volume exploration of memory, desire, art and French society, set in motion by the taste of a madeleine dipped in tea.

title: Anna Karenina
description: An aristocratic woman's affair with Count Vronsky destroys her place in Russian society, set against Levin's search for meaning on his country estate.

title: War and Peace
description: Several aristocratic Russian families live through the Napoleonic wars in a panoramic novel that blends intimate drama with reflections on history.

title: Jane Eyre
description: An orphaned governess with a fierce sense of self falls for her brooding employer, Mr Rochester, whose house conceals a terrible secret.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr Darcy overcome first impressions and their own failings in a sharp comedy of manners about marriage, money and class.

title: Madame Bovary
description: A doctor's wife in provincial Normandy, fed on romantic novels, seeks escape through affairs and debts in a landmark of realist fiction.

title: The Great Gatsby
description: Narrator Nick Carraway watches his mysterious, wealthy neighbour pursue a lost love across a glittering, hollow Jazz Age Long Island.

title: Bleak House
description: An endless inheritance suit in the Court of Chancery entangles dozens of lives in Dickens's sprawling satire of the law and Victorian society.

title: Emma
description: A clever, self-assured young woman meddles in her neighbours' romances while misreading her own heart.

title: Mrs Dalloway
description: One June day in London, as Clarissa Dalloway prepares for a party, her life is set alongside that of a shell-shocked veteran.

title: Moby-Dick
description: Captain Ahab's obsessive hunt for the white whale becomes a vast, digressive inquiry into nature, fate and the limits of knowledge.

title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
description: Winston Smith rebels against a totalitarian state that controls truth, language and thought itself.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
description: Seven generations of the Buendía family rise and fall in the town of Macondo in the defining work of magical realism.

title: Persuasion
description: Years after being talked out of marrying a naval officer, Anne Elliot meets him again in Austen's most autumnal novel of second chances.

title: The Life and Opinions of Tristram Shandy, Gentleman
description: A narrator who can barely get himself born digresses endlessly in a playful, experimental comic novel centuries ahead of its time.

title: Wuthering Heights
description: The destructive passion between Catherine Earnshaw and Heathcliff spreads across two generations on the Yorkshire moors.

title: The Portrait of a Lady
description: A spirited American heiress in Europe makes a fateful choice of husband, testing her belief in her own freedom.

title: Things Fall Apart
description: The proud Igbo warrior Okonkwo faces the arrival of British colonialism and Christian missionaries in late 19th-century Nigeria.

title: Midnight's Children
description: Born at the moment of Indian independence, Saleem Sinai finds his life magically bound to the fortunes of the new nation.

title: The Remains of the Day
description: An English butler on a motoring trip looks back on his years of service and the loyalties that cost him love.

title: Lolita
description: A seductively eloquent narrator tries to justify his abuse of a 12-year-old girl, in a novel whose dazzling prose exposes his self-deception.

title: Don Quixote
description: A Spanish gentleman driven mad by chivalric romances sets out as a knight with his squire Sancho Panza, in what is often called the first modern novel.

title: The Trial
description: Josef K is arrested by an unseen authority for an unnamed crime and drawn into a nightmarish, impenetrable legal system.

title: The Brothers Karamazov
description: The murder of a debauched father implicates his sons in a philosophical novel wrestling with faith, doubt and moral responsibility.

title: Pale Fire
description: A 999-line poem is hijacked by its deranged annotator, whose commentary tells a very different story, in a metafictional puzzle.

title: Frankenstein
description: A young scientist creates a living being and then abandons it, with tragic consequences, in a founding text of science fiction.

title: The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie
description: A charismatic Edinburgh teacher shapes a select group of girls in the 1930s, until one of them betrays her.

title: The God of Small Things
description: Twins in Kerala live through a family tragedy shaped by caste, forbidden love and the rules about who may be loved and how much.

title: David Copperfield
description: Dickens's most autobiographical novel follows its hero from a hard childhood to maturity and a life as a writer.

title: Wolf Hall
description: Thomas Cromwell, a blacksmith's son, rises to become Henry VIII's indispensable fixer in the years of the king's break with Rome.

title: Great Expectations
description: The orphan Pip receives a fortune from a mysterious benefactor and learns hard lessons about ambition, snobbery and loyalty.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
description: In a theocratic future America, women are stripped of their rights and a handmaid named Offred is forced to bear children for the elite.

title: Invisible Man
description: An unnamed Black narrator tells of his journey from the American south to Harlem, unseen by a society that refuses to recognise him.

title: The Age of Innocence
description: A lawyer in 1870s New York high society is torn between his conventional fiancée and her unconventional cousin.

title: Their Eyes Were Watching God
description: Janie Crawford tells of her three marriages and her search for independence and love in early 20th-century Florida.

title: Song of Solomon
description: Milkman Dead's journey south to uncover his family history becomes a quest for identity and freedom.

title: Heart of Darkness
description: Marlow travels up the Congo river in search of the ivory trader Kurtz, confronting the brutality of European colonialism.

title: The Magic Mountain
description: A young engineer's planned three-week visit to a Swiss sanatorium stretches to seven years in a novel of ideas on the eve of the first world war.

title: Housekeeping
description: Two orphaned sisters in a remote Idaho town are raised by their eccentric, drifting aunt, and grow apart.

title: Giovanni's Room
description: An American in Paris is torn between his fiancée and his love for an Italian barman.

title: The Golden Notebook
description: A writer divides her life into four notebooks, covering politics, fiction, love and daily life, before trying to unify them in a fifth.

title: The Leopard
description: A Sicilian prince watches his aristocratic world fade as Italy is unified in the 1860s.

title: Vanity Fair
description: The ruthless, charming Becky Sharp schemes her way up through English society during the Napoleonic era in this 'novel without a hero'.

title: The Metamorphosis
description: Gregor Samsa wakes one morning transformed into a giant insect, to his family's horror and growing resentment.

title: A Fine Balance
description: Four strangers are thrown together in a Bombay flat during India's Emergency of the mid-1970s.

title: Wide Sargasso Sea
description: A prequel to Jane Eyre that tells the story of Rochester's first wife, a Creole heiress, from her youth in Jamaica.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description: The first of the Neapolitan novels traces the intense, competitive friendship between two girls growing up in a poor Naples neighbourhood.

title: The Golden Bowl
description: A wealthy American and his daughter marry into a web of hidden relationships, in James's dense late-period study of deception.

title: The Transit of Venus
description: Two Australian sisters make lives in postwar England, in a richly patterned novel of love, fate and betrayal.

title: Orlando
description: A young Elizabethan nobleman lives for centuries and wakes one day as a woman, in Woolf's playful fantasy of gender and history.

title: The Waves
description: Six friends' lives from childhood to old age are rendered through poetic interior monologues.

title: Mansfield Park
description: Fanny Price, a poor relation raised by wealthy cousins, holds to her principles as the household is unsettled by worldly newcomers.

title: The Sound and the Fury
description: The decline of a southern family, the Compsons, is told through four perspectives, beginning with the fractured mind of Benjy.

title: Disgrace
description: A disgraced Cape Town professor retreats to his daughter's farm, where violence forces a reckoning in post-apartheid South Africa.

title: Never Let Me Go
description: Former pupils of an English boarding school slowly come to understand the purpose for which they were raised.

title: Howards End
description: The intellectual Schlegel sisters and the commercial Wilcox family become entangled over a country house in Edwardian England.

title: The Rings of Saturn
description: A walking tour of the Suffolk coast unspools into meditations on history, destruction and memory, illustrated with grainy photographs.

title: Half of a Yellow Sun
description: The Nigerian civil war and the short-lived state of Biafra are seen through the lives of a houseboy, a professor and twin sisters.

title: White Teeth
description: Two wartime friends and their families navigate identity, religion and race in multicultural north-west London.

title: The Good Soldier
description: An American narrator pieces together, unreliably, the betrayals within two couples he thought he knew.

title: The Color Purple
description: Celie, a poor Black woman in the rural American south, finds her voice through letters to God and her sister.

title: The Master and Margarita
description: The devil visits Soviet Moscow, causing chaos, in a satirical fantasy interwoven with a story of Pontius Pilate.

title: The Man Without Qualities
description: Ulrich, a detached intellectual, observes Viennese society on the eve of the first world war in an unfinished novel of ideas.

title: Blood Meridian
description: A teenage runaway joins a band of scalp hunters on the US-Mexico border in a violent, biblical western.

title: Crime and Punishment
description: An impoverished former student in St Petersburg commits murder to test a theory, then wrestles with guilt.

title: Jude the Obscure
description: A stonemason's hopes of a university education and a life with his cousin Sue are crushed by class and convention.

title: Kindred
description: A Black woman in 1970s California is repeatedly pulled back in time to a Maryland plantation before the Civil War.

title: Our Mutual Friend
description: A fortune made from dust heaps and a body pulled from the Thames set off Dickens's last completed novel about money and identity.

title: Austerlitz
description: An architectural historian slowly recovers the story of how he was brought to Britain as a child on a Kindertransport.

title: Nervous Conditions
description: A girl in colonial Rhodesia gets the chance of a mission-school education after her brother's death.

title: The Bluest Eye
description: An 11-year-old Black girl in Ohio longs for blue eyes, believing they would make her beautiful and loved.

title: Dracula
description: A Transylvanian count comes to England, and a group led by Van Helsing sets out to destroy him, told through letters and diaries.

title: The Rainbow
description: Three generations of the Brangwen family in the English Midlands search for fulfilment in love and work.

title: A House for Mr Biswas
description: An Indo-Trinidadian man struggles throughout his life to own a house of his own and assert his independence.

title: Go Tell It on the Mountain
description: On his 14th birthday, a Harlem teenager confronts his relationship with his stepfather, a preacher, and with the church.

title: Rebecca
description: A young second wife arrives at Manderley and finds herself overshadowed by the memory of her husband's first wife.

title: Buddenbrooks
description: A wealthy merchant family in Lübeck declines over four generations.

title: The End of the Affair
description: A novelist investigates why his married lover abruptly ended their wartime affair, and finds a rival he didn't expect.

title: A Farewell to Arms
description: An American ambulance driver on the Italian front falls in love with an English nurse during the first world war.

title: The Talented Mr Ripley
description: Tom Ripley is sent to Italy to bring home a rich man's son and becomes dangerously drawn into his life.

title: The Vegetarian
description: A Seoul woman's decision to stop eating meat provokes violent reactions from her family, told in three parts by those around her.

title: The Turn of the Screw
description: A governess at a remote English country house becomes convinced that the two children in her care are being haunted.

title: The Line of Beauty
description: A young gay man lodges with the family of a Tory MP during the Thatcher years and the onset of the Aids crisis.

title: Ragtime
description: Three families' lives intersect with historical figures in early 20th-century New York.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
description: An envoy to a frozen planet whose inhabitants have no fixed sex must learn to trust someone he does not understand.

title: Jacob's Room
description: A young man's life up to the first world war is pieced together from the impressions of those who knew him.

title: Life and Fate
description: A sprawling novel of the battle of Stalingrad that sets Nazi and Soviet totalitarianism side by side.

title: Sentimental Education
description: A young man's long, unrequited love for an older married woman plays out against the 1848 revolution in Paris.

title: Invisible Cities
description: Marco Polo describes a series of imaginary cities to Kublai Khan in a book of prose poems about memory and desire.

title: The Known World
description: A formerly enslaved Black man in Virginia becomes a slaveholder himself, in a novel about the moral contradictions of slavery.

title: The Return of the Native
description: A man returns from Paris to the brooding Egdon Heath and marries the restless Eustacia Vye, with tragic results.

title: Pedro Páramo
description: A man travels to the town of Comala to find his father and discovers it is full of ghosts.

title: Catch-22
description: A US bombardier in the second world war tries to escape the absurd military logic that keeps him flying missions.

title: The Road
description: A father and son travel through a burned, post-apocalyptic America.

title: The Go-Between
description: An elderly man remembers the summer of 1900 when, as a boy, he carried secret messages between two lovers.

title: My Ántonia
description: A man recalls growing up on the Nebraska prairie and his friendship with a Bohemian immigrant girl.
